headline: SPAIN 🇪🇸 BANS 🚫 EVICTIONS 🏠 Until 2030 After 87yo 🧓 Drama
text:
SPAIN 🇪🇸 just DROPPED 🫳 a HOUSING 🍃 BOMBSHELL 💥 after WEEKS 🗓️ of PROTESTS 🪧 over an 87 YEAR OLD 🧓 grandma 👵 getting STRETCHER 🚑 EVICTED 🏚️ from her FLAT 🛏️ in MADRID 🏙️ last WEEK 📆!! The COALITION 🤝 government 🏛️ led by PEDRO 🧔 SÁNCHEZ approved new MEASURES 📜 including a full BAN 🚫 on EVICTIONS 🏠 until TWENTY THIRTY 🗓️ to give RELIEF 😌 to over FIVE MILLION 🧮 struggling CITIZENS 👥!! Health MINISTER 👩‍⚕️ MÓNICA 🗣️ GARCÍA called it a WIN 🏆 for the PEOPLE 👏 after the MOBILISATIONS 🪑 and ENCAMPMENTS ⛺ pushed them to ACT ⚡ saying without YOU 🫵 this would NOT ❌ have happened!! Opposition voices 🗣️ like MÍRIAM 🧍‍♀️ NOGUERAS complained it leaves SMALL 🐜 LANDLORDS 🏘️ out in the COLD ❄️ lumping them with VULTURE 🦅 FUNDS 💰 but the DECREES 📑 take effect IMMEDIATELY ⏰ anyway!!

MINISTERS 🧑‍💼 huddled on TUESDAY 📅 to hammer out these PROPOSALS 📋 that also include ROLLING 🌀 over rental CONTRACTS 📝 until TWENTY TWENTY EIGHT 🗓️ stricter RULES 📏 on short term 🏨 and ROOM 🛏️ rentals plus a total BAN 🚫 on INVESTMENT 🏦 FIRMS buying up HOUSES 🏡!! Pedro's LEFTIST 🌹 coalition lacks a full MAJORITY 🗳️ and previously got their rental ROLLOVER 🧾 decree BLOCKED 🚫 by right leaning PARTIES 🏛️ back in APRIL 🌸 so this time they went down to the WIRE 🪢 before cabinet APPROVAL 👍!! GARCÍA 🗣️ stressed it is TIME ⏰ to intervene in the SPECULATIVE 💸 housing MARKET 🛒 and strike a BALANCE ⚖️ between ordinary CITIZENS 👥 and those VULTURE 🦅 FUNDS 🤑 while HOUSING MINISTER 🏠 ISABEL 🧍‍♀️ RODRÍGUEZ urged everyone to back the plan so MARICARMEN's 🧓 suffering was not in VAIN 🙏!!

THESE 📜 two DECREES 🧾 must still get APPROVED ✅ by CONGRESS 🏛️ within the next THIRTY 🗓️ days although the government hopes for a VOTE 🗳️ as soon as this FRIDAY 🗓️!! The minority setup made up of SOCIALISTS 👥 and the SUMAR 🤝 alliance had to NEGOTIATE 🗣️ hard with BUSTINDUY 🧔 pushing for a FIRST STEP 👣 toward economic and SOCIAL 🔄 transformation of the COUNTRY 🇪🇸!! Protests 🪧 erupted last WEEK 📆 in MADRID 🏙️ then SPREAD 🌍 to BARCELONA 🏖️ SEVILLE 🌆 MALAGA 🏖️ and CADIZ 🌊 with THOUSANDS 👥 marching through the CAPITAL 🏛️ and hundreds of TENTS ⛺ popping up in PUERTA DEL SOL 🏟️!! Bank of SPAIN 🇪🇸 says the country is short SEVEN HUNDRED THOUSAND 🏠 homes while house PRICES 📈 shot up TWELVE POINT TWO PERCENT 📊 in the last YEAR 📅 and rents climbed EIGHT POINT FIVE PERCENT 💸 with MADRID 🏙️ and BARCELONA 🏖️ the most EXPENSIVE 💰 at over TWENTY EUROS 🪙 per square METRE 📏!!

MARICARMEN 🧓 ABASCAL became the unwilling FACE 😶 of the HOUSING 🏚️ CRISIS after she was hauled out on a STRETCHER 🚑 from the very FLAT 🛋️ her father first RENTED 🗝️ back in NINETEEN FIFTY SIX 🗓️!! The investment company URBA 🏢 GESTIÓN bought the PROPERTY 🏠 in TWENTY EIGHTEEN 🗓️ then jacked the monthly RENT 💸 higher than her PENSION 🤑 leaving the poor woman UNABLE ❌ to pay and sparking MASSIVE 🏴‍☠️ outrage!! Her LAWYER 🧑‍⚖️ announced she can now RETURN 🏡 after striking a DEAL 🤝 with the OWNERS 🏢 although she is still in HOSPITAL 🏥 and has not SIGNED 📝 yet!! Meanwhile in ZARAGOZA 🏙️ another woman's EVICTION 🚪 for a FIFTY ONE YEAR OLD 🧍‍♀️ single mom with an ELEVEN YEAR OLD 🧒 daughter got temporarily SUSPENDED ⏸️ because she simply could not afford the RENT 🧾 on top of daily living COSTS 💸!!

VALERIA 🗣️ RACU from the MADRID 🏙️ TENANTS UNION declared the BATTLE ⚔️ has only JUST BEGUN 🆕 and called for even MORE 🗣️ protests across SPAIN 🇪🇸 next WEEKEND 🗓️ while her colleague ALICIA 🧍‍♀️ DEL RÍO said everyone is staring at the SMALL PRINT 🔎 to make sure this truly becomes the MARICARMEN 🧓 DECREE 📜!! PABLO 🧔 BUSTINDUY of the SUMAR alliance described the whole PACKAGE 📦 as a first STEP 👟 toward real change even though it has already RAISED 🤚 the HACKLES 😠 of the JUNTS 🏛️ party whose support will likely be needed again to get it PASSED 🗳️!! The right leaning groups tend to hate intervening in the HOUSING 🏠 market especially if it tips the scales toward TENANTS 👥 instead of their LANDLORD 🏘️ voters but the SOCIAL MOMENTUM 🔥 from this case might just OVERRIDE 🚀 those reservations and turn these MEASURES 📋 into actual LAW ⚖️!!
